# QAMAR Blowdry Lounge — Dubai

> Women-only walk-in lounge opening in Dubai in March 2027, off Sheikh Zayed Road (between Mall of the Emirates and DIFC). In 45 minutes maximum: a private shower, the guest's outfit (dress, abaya, hijab) steamed and lightly perfumed, a blow-dry, and a drink (coffee, tea, matcha, fresh juice or iced drinks) served on a tray. No appointment needed. All-female team. Bilingual English / Arabic.

- Website (English): https://qamarlounge.com/
- Website (Arabic): https://qamarlounge.com/ar.html
- Services: private shower, outfit steaming and perfuming, blow-dry (sleek, bouncy, waves, curls), optional nails, drinks
- Signature looks: Midnight Sleek, Qamar Glow, Marina Waves, Desert Curls
- Membership: the price goes down each quarter a member stays; founding members get the best starting price. Prices are published before opening.
- Opening: March 2027, with a private preview before the public opening. Exact address announced soon.
- Guides: https://qamarlounge.com/guides/get-ready-after-work-dubai.html · https://qamarlounge.com/guides/blow-dry-dubai-humidity.html · https://qamarlounge.com/guides/steam-abaya-hijab.html
